detailed.zh: 可见面与背面已形成完整 PBR 网格; 轻微生成纹理差异按当前验收口径保留。

location.en: At the 右后排 position on the mattress.
location.zh: 位于床垫上的右后排位置。

short.en: A light-colored 右后排 pillow on the bed.
short.zh: 床上的右后排浅色软枕。

appearance.en: Light bedding over a dark wooden frame and headboard.
appearance.zh: 浅色床垫与床品配深色木质床架和床头板。

detailed.en: Six closed PBR parts act as one selectable, rotatable, collidable root.
detailed.zh: 床由六个闭合 PBR 部件组成, 但在场景中由一个根节点统一选择、旋转和碰撞。

location.en: In the bedroom center, supporting the three pillows.
location.zh: 位于卧室中央, 三只枕头在床垫上。

short.en: A double bed with mattress, frame, and headboard.
short.zh: 一张带软垫、床架和床头板的双人床。
